summary: Hosted API: intermittent 504s / request timeouts on chat completions (us-east)
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer reports 504 gateway timeouts on /v1/chat/completions.

Impact:
- End users see timeouts after ~30s, retries sometimes succeed.
- Approx error rate reported by customer: 2-5% over last hour.

Primary symptom: Request timeouts
Deployment offering: Hosted API

Environment:
- prod, us-east
- model: rw-chat-3.1

Initial triage notes:
- Correlates with elevated queue depth on shared gateway pool.
- No auth failures observed; looks like upstream request expiry.

Links:
- Slack: https://slack.com/app_redirect?channel=support (thread referenced in comments)
comments: Chloe Martin (2026-03-03): Marking as escalation per policy. Labeling offering-hosted + symptom-timeout.
Jordan Blake (2026-03-03): Seeing spikes in gateway queue in us-east only. Suspect one bad node in pool.
Jordan Blake (2026-03-03): Drained gateway node gw-us-east-17; timeouts dropped immediately.
Chloe Martin (2026-03-04): Customer confirmed stable for 12h. Closing as resolved.
